lines.trans: Lyova, sit here and watch over Alisa.
Do not take your eyes off her.
And do not give her chocolate, she has an allergy.
Uncle Lyova, let us play!
Maybe we could just sit here instead?
I will tell Dad, he will fire you!
All right, what should we play?
Let us play hide and seek!
And who will hide?
Of course, I will hide!
You are so tall, you cannot be hidden anywhere.
Close your eyes, count to a hundred.
One, two, three, four...
Count slowly, I am going to hide!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: 'закрывать глаза на' + accusative = to turn a blind eye to

examples.text: Я не буду закрывать на это глаза.
examples.trans: I'm not going to close my eyes to this.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular
masculine, but declined like a feminine noun in -я
colloquial, as children say; дяди из Москвы = some people from Moscow

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Напиши: трус не играет в хоккей.
examples.trans: Write: a coward doesn't play hockey.
The children are playing in the courtyard.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: В том смысле, что его нигде нет!
examples.trans: In the sense that he is nowhere to be found!

examples.text: Я нигде не мог найти ключи.
examples.trans: I could find the keys nowhere.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: declines like a feminine noun in -а, but is masculine

посидеть.gloss: to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)

meanings.note: посиди с ним = stay with him

examples.trans: Stay with Vika for a while.
Let's sit in a café for a bit.

meanings.en: to hide oneself, to be in hiding

examples.trans: Children love hiding in the wardrobe.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Why are you sitting in the corner?
Do not take your eyes off her.

meanings.note: сто пятьдесят = a hundred and fifty; сто рублей = a hundred roubles

examples.trans: I've got a hundred and ten.

считать.gloss: to count; to think, to consider

meanings.note: я считаю, что... = I think that...

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
